chbmit.scope: Exploratory, pointwise paired whole-group bootstrap, conditional on fitted models; no adjustment for dataset/model selection and no source-training uncertainty. LANL stratifies configurations by class.
chbmit.diagnostic: Matched no-z removes z while retaining the fusion baseline projection, ridge penalty and RBF bandwidth; head refitted on sources only. It is a post-result attribution diagnostic, not a new selected primary baseline.
